description: Passively inspect one selected page target through CDP without evaluating JavaScript, navigating, clicking, closing, or mutating the page. If no origin filter is supplied, capture is scoped to the target's current origin. Returns DOM structure, accessibility, scripts, resources, attach-window network and console metadata, workers, and redacted storage inventory as Evidence.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.

include_accessibility_text.description: Whether to include accessibility text in the result.

include_console_text.description: Whether to include console text in the result.

include_json_body_shapes.description: Whether to include json body shapes in the result.

include_script_sources.description: Whether to include script sources in the result.

include_storage_fingerprints.description: Whether to include storage fingerprints in the result.

include_storage_keys.description: Whether to include storage keys in the result.

include_websocket_shapes.description: Whether to include websocket shapes in the result.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.
